---
title: "Cite surveyframe"
description: "How to cite surveyframe in a thesis or paper: the APA 7 reference, the BibTeX entry and the DOI."
---

If surveyframe helped your research, please cite it. In R,
`citation("surveyframe")` prints the reference for the version you have.

## APA 7

Sharafuddin, M. A. (2026). *surveyframe: Survey instrument workflows* (R
package version 0.4.3) [Computer software].
https://doi.org/10.32614/CRAN.package.surveyframe

## BibTeX

```
@Manual{surveyframe,
  title  = {surveyframe: Survey Instrument Workflows},
  author = {Mohammed Ali Sharafuddin},
  year   = {2026},
  note   = {R package version 0.4.3},
  url    = {https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=surveyframe},
  doi    = {10.32614/CRAN.package.surveyframe},
}
```

## Cite the instrument too

A study's `.sframe` file carries a SHA-256 hash. Name it beside the citation,
so a reader can check at [surveyframe.org/verify](https://surveyframe.org/verify/)
that the questionnaire analysed is the one planned.
